cohort.candidate_domain: complete held-out eligible domain; bank_id NA; positives verified against all three fixed banks

definitions: incoming support without directed two-edge upstream path
groups.held_graph: fixed G2/D8 test graph from structure_inputs; unchanged across seeds and variants

estimand: C_g(s)=sum over positive i in group g of precision at inclusive exact-score threshold s_i, divided by ALL positives. No within-group reranking. Report 100*C_g in pp.

pairs.signed_symmetrization: all six ordered pairs, exact reversals; dependent, not p-values

aggregation: compute each pair per city/fold/revelation; average five revelations within each fold then five folds equally. Keep all unit and fold aggregate values, all three fixed-pair city effects and all six signed effects.
graph_effect: FF-G2-1 minus FF-G0-1 per matched slot; average three seed-specific group outcomes (never average predictions), then five revelations, then five folds. Reproduce archived L group and overall fold effects; validate Zhengzhou L2 rounds to -0.182 pp.
seed_checks: verify actual SHA256-derived uint128 and torch mod 2^63 for each slot, selected config/refit epochs and training sample identity; report config-dependent cross-variant seed mismatches instead of claiming common actual seeds.

randomized_reference.scheme: independently per unit uniformly choose one of six ordered pairs; same draw choices across groups for additivity; average revelations within fold then folds; report q.025/q.975 with numpy linear quantiles and all draw aggregates
randomized_reference.interpretation: empirical seed-sensitivity reference only, not population null, p-value, CI, or variance-matched test; graph contrast averages three seed fits whereas reference uses one pair

comparison: show observed group effect relative to BOTH full six-signed fixed-pair envelope and randomized q.025/q.975; also show full draw min/max; no selection by results; compare group with same group only
dispersion: separately describe 75 raw unordered unit-pair values per city/group (and 150 signed), 15 fold-pair values, and 3 fixed-pair city averages (6 signed). Descriptive SD/range/RMS/quantiles; never independent replicates.
sensitivity: all three graph-delta leave-one-seed-slot-out means, every fold sign and single-slot means
validation: all-task receipts/selections/provenance verified with existing loaders
complete matrix, frozen memberships, positive/domain identity, pair antisymmetry/cycle and hierarchy checks
restrictions: write generated analysis artifacts only beneath the explicit --output directory
read prepared inputs only beneath --root and explicitly supplied provenance inputs
aggregate outputs only; no individual predictions/labels/coordinates or grid IDs exported
status: frozen before any prediction score loading; post-review diagnostic, not prospective preregistration

portable_release_provenance.changes: Portable input/output restrictions replace machine-specific operational restrictions. Scientific settings and original freeze metadata are retained. Historical archive comparisons are opt-in for fresh runs.
portable_release_provenance.historical_target: The -0.182 pp value and archive reproduction clauses describe the original run, not an acceptance threshold for fresh training.
